title: Fabada Asturiana
description: Traditional Asturian bean stew originating from the Asturias region in Spain

ingredients.name: Warm Spanish sausage
ingredients.notes: Cook to an internal temperature of at least 160°F (71°C)

ingredients.name: Stock
ingredients.notes: Use beef or pork stock for authentic flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add sliced Spanish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add smoked paprika, tomato paste, and cook for 1 minute.
Add white wine and cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes.
Add stock, dried Fabada beans, salt, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1-2 hours, or until beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
